tei:div.tei:p: 327) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: dbang chen drag po'i bskul pa rdo rje'i thog mda' bzhugs: na mo pad+ma kro dha ye:

pad+ma he ru ka la 'dud: zab lam nyams su len pa yi: rjes 'jug rnams kyi don ched du: bskul ba rdo rje'i thog mda' bstan: sa ma ya: bskul gtor sha khrag dag gis brgyan: dgra bo'i bla tshe srog gsum dang: gnyis med bstim la 'gugs zhug bya: rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyis: gsum rngams khros pa'i gar dang bcas: dbyings nas lha tshogs skul ba ni: hūm̐ bh+yo: chos dbyings 'gyur ba med pa'i ngang nyid las: log rtog 'dul mdzad dbang drag khros pa'i sku: bcom ldan pad+ma rta mgrin dbang gi lha: chos nyid stong dbyings phag mo yum dang bcas: chos kyi dbyings las gzugs kyi skur bzhengs la: log 'dren bdud bgegs 'dul ba'i dus la babs: bskul lo thugs dam gnyen po dbyings nas bskul: bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas skur bzhengs shig: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dam nyams dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i dus la babs: rgya 'dre 'gong po 'dul ba'i= dam sri rgyal bsen 'dul ba'i= mi phyugs 328) nad yams zlog pa'i= mtha' dmag dus 'khrugs bzlog pa'i= byad zor phur kha bzlog pa'i= mi 'dod nyer 'tshe bzlog pa'i= mtha' 'dre gdug pa 'dul ba'i= thugs dam ma g.yel ma 'da' sa ma ya: bcol pa'i phrin las myur du 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yo: dbang chen thugs las sprul pa'i sras mchog ni: rigs bzhi h+ya grī wa yab yum 'khor: chos kyi dbyings nas gzugs kyi skur bzhengs la: bskul lo thugs dam gnyen po dbyings nas bskul: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dam nyams dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i dus la babs: rgya 'dre 'gong po 'dul ba'i= dam sri rgyal bsen 'dul ba'i= mtha' mi hor 'dre 'dul ba'i= mi nad phyugs nad bzlog pa'i= mtha' dmag dus 'khrugs bzlog pa'i= byad zor phur dbal bzlog pa'i= mi 'dod nyer 'tshe bzlog pa'i= thugs dam ma g.yel ma 'da' sa ma ya: rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las myur 'grub mdzod:

hūm̐ bh+yo: dbang chen thugs las sprul pa'i sras mchog ni: phyogs bcu'i bdud 'dul drag po'i skur ston pa: khro bcu yab yum za 329) gsod sprul par bcas: chos kyi dbyings nas gzugs kyi skur bzhengs la: bskul lo thugs dam gnyen po dbyings nas bskul: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dam nyams dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i dus la babs: rgya 'dre 'gong po 'dul ba'i= dam sri rgyal bsen 'dul ba'i= mtha' mi hor 'dre 'dul ba'i= mi phyugs nad yams bzlog pa'i= mtha' dmag dus 'khrugs bzlog pa'i= byad zor phur dbal bzlog pa'i= mi 'dod nyer 'tshe bzlog pa'i= thugs dam ma g.yel ma 'da' sa ma ya: bcol ba'i phrin las ma lus myur 'grub mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yoḥ dbang chen dkyil 'khor mtha' skyong dregs pa'i tshogs: pho nya ging dang dbang phyug bstan ma skyong: sde brgyad dregs chen bco brgyad 'khor dang bcas: gtum drag rngams pa'i sku ru da bzhengs la: thugs dam bskul lo mngon spyod phrin las mdzod: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sngon gyi tha tshig g.yar dam ma 'dor bar: zhing bcu'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dus la babs: rgya 'dre 'gong po 'dul ba'i= dam sri rgyal bsen 'dul ba'i= mtha' mi hor 'dre 'dul ba'i= 330)mi phyugs nad yams bzlog pa'i= mtha' dmag dus 'khrugs bzlog pa'i= byad zor phur dbal bzlog pa'i= mi 'dod nyer 'tshe bzlog pa'i= ma g.yel ma g.yel thugs dam dus la babs: bcol ba'i las 'di myur du 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yo: ma g.yel ma 'gyang pad+ma dbang gi lha: thugs rje zhi ba'i dbyings su mi bzhugs par: gar dgu'i nyams rdzogs drag khros skur ston la: glog ltar myur ba'i phrin las dus la babs: zhing bcu'i dgra dang gnod par byed pa'i bgegs: rgya 'dre me zhon 'byung po rlung zhon dang: dam sri rgyal bsen yul 'dra bgegs kyi rigs: sangs rgyas bstan bshig dkon mchog dbu 'phang smad:

dge 'dun sde dkrugs bstan 'dzin sku la bsdo: sems can yongs kyi bde skyid la gnod pa'i: dgra bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs rnams kun: rjes med shul med brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod: bdag cag rnal 'byor lha mchog khyod la re: khyed rnams thugs dam ma g.yel dgongs mdzod la: bcol ba'i las 'di 'grub mdzod sa ma ya: ces brjod bskul gtor 'bul zhing phrin las bcol: gang bsam drag po'i 331) 'dod don 'grub par nges: zab po myur ro 'di nyid nyams su longs: skal ldan las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: skal med log lta can la 'di ma 'phrad: bka' srung dregs pa'i tshogs kyis gnyer gyis shig: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: brda thim: : ces pa 'di'ang mkhan po nor bu dbang rgyal dang rang slob dam pa shes rab 'od zer/ nye gnas yi ge'i 'du byed shākya'i dge btsun tshul khrims rdo rje dang bu mo chos dbyings sgron ma sogs kyis bskul ba don yod pa'i phyir kun bzang bde skyong dbang mos zab gter kha bskang phyir du nyams chos yig ris su bris pa'o// maṅga lam// 332)
